sources.label: Ethereum mMEV verified implementation (mMEV imports mTBILL)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224764 (2026-10-19), mMEV proxy 0x030b69280892c888670edcdcd8b69fd8026a0bf3 resolves to verified implementation 0x4fe7f62b2f4ef077aed8f458c8b4652f5de8080f. mMEV inherits mTBILL/mToken, whose _beforeTokenTransfer applies _onlyNotBlacklisted to sender and recipient, with role-gated pause (M_MEV_PAUSE_OPERATOR_ROLE) and privileged burn (M_MEV_BURN_OPERATOR_ROLE). The shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312A9D1Ff2372DDEdCBB21e4B6389aFc919aC4B held 60+ current BLACKLIST_OPERATOR_ROLE members at that block (hasRole true for 0x081bb8ad7f452f916991c17fdfa64d4a25153169), so an issuer operator can blacklist any holder and stop transfers. Ethereum held 1,250,321.76 of 1,269,370.16 mMEV measured across deployments (98.50%), a material deployment. Etherlink (16,015.19; 1.26%) and Plume (3,033.21; 0.24%) are sub-threshold and disclosed; their native deployments were not role-verified.

oracleRisk.summary: mMEV is a NAV-accreting Midas Liquid Yield Token tracking a delta-neutral DeFi strategy; its underlying protocols can have liquidation risk, but mMEV is not itself a borrower CDP.

branchApplicability.rationale: Midas documents mMEV as a NAV-accreting Liquid Yield Token for a delta-neutral strategy and identifies the token's NAV-based valuation and redemption rails. The underlying strategy may interact with liquidation venues, but mMEV itself has no borrower-owned collateral branch; its NAV is the applicable top-level value authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: mMEV has three independently native Midas issuance deployments on Ethereum, Plume, and Etherlink. Bridge Risk therefore contains only reviewed native route identities; no production OFT/OToken, lockbox, escrow, peer, validator, bridge-admin, or bridge-specific rate-limit control is evidenced. The mint-vault, admin-role, and delayed proxy-upgrade authorities remain exclusively in Mint Authority as native issuance controls. The issuer-native-burn-mint tier describes these native routes, not a third-party bridge.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance); Codex mint-bridge-boundary migration 2026-08-16
